full_text:
Wormwalker is a terrifying Meso-Titan that does not actually have a solid body. Everything under its robes is just a big pile of worms, bugs, and slime.

== History ==
The Aztecs, believing Wormwalker to be an evil spirit, created rituals in an attempt to defend against this Titan. [TCG:SAS-097]

== Abilities ==
Wormwalker can separate its body back into its composite worms, bugs, and slime.
